CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), presentation/organization (origin) and status (completed_record) are all explicitly stated for p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to a content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (colour-labeled coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: Origin metadata (kind: completed_record) distinguishes content identity from its presentation/status.

O.rationale: Explicit statements describe how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation and origin/represented_time).
